archetypes.name: publish-contract
archetypes.rationale: Cross-checks exit-code and PUBLISH_OK envelope contracts across direct and indirect publish callers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect whether the plan aligns every publish caller and callee on exit-code handling, PUBLISH_OK parsing, recovery branch preservation, and fail-closed behavior. Compare the proposed changes against the actual call sites in design-publish, design-log-publish, pause-save, and clarify prose so no path keeps trusting a contradictory success envelope. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: resume-state
archetypes.rationale: Targets Step 5c sentinel and pause/resume state-machine gaps that generic reviewers may miss.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the plan’s claims about the real step-completion writer, the first-missing-step resume rule, and the intended sentinel behavior for publish success, publish failure, and missing SESSION_ID. Look for mismatches between SKILL.md orchestration prose, pause-save behavior, structure tests, and the described idempotence assumptions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: summary-operator
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on operator-facing summary truthfulness and cross-script run-log path consistency.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether the proposed publish-skipped outcome is consistently represented from design-publish through render-final-summary and render-run-summary without leaking fake unknown run-log paths or failed-publish recovery language. Confirm the test and doc plan covers both primary rendering and fallback rendering paths that operators may see. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: repo-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Reviews malformed repo validation as a targeting-boundary change across scripts, docs, and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the plan’s validate_repo scope and exact rejection rules match the existing repository-targeting boundary and all direct invocation surfaces. Check for missing validation before gh or stateful work, inconsistent exit conventions, under-tested malformed cases, and SECURITY.md contract drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
